proposed_widenings.name: random_table_resolution
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's failure mode is a percentile-driven random-effects table with nested random rolls. The current surface has no honest way to model stochastic branching or table lookups.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed check, you fail to cast the spell and a random effect occurs instead, determined by rolling on the following table.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spell_list_filter
proposed_widenings.justification: The item does not grant access to one named spell. It attempts a one-off cast of any qualifying Wizard spell the wielder does not know, filtered by class list, level capability, and material-cost ceiling.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding the hat, you can try to cast a level 1+ spell you don't know. The spell must be on the Wizard spell list, it must be of a level you can cast, and it can't have Material components costing more than 1,000 GP.

proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord.attunementRestriction
proposed_widenings.justification: The current record can only say whether attunement is required, not who can attune. This item requires attunement by a Wizard specifically.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Wondrous Item, Very Rare (Requires Attunement by a Wizard)

notes: No content file was authored. A composite magic-item shell would fit, but the core Unknown Spell property cannot be represented honestly without a random-table subgraph, and the passive Spellcasting Focus rider is also currently unmodeled.
